method: ./query "SELECT SUM(seats * (unit_price_minor / POWER(10, minor_unit_exponent)) * usd_per_unit * (1 - discount_pct) / CASE WHEN billing_interval = 'year' THEN 12 ELSE 1 END) as mrr_usd FROM marts.fct_subscription_months WHERE month_end = '2025-06-30' AND status = 'active';"

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT apc.account_id) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(DISTINCT ac.account_id) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM marts.fct_subscription_months WHERE month_end = '2025-03-31' AND status IN ('active', 'past_due', 'trialing')) ac LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM marts.fct_subscription_months WHERE month_end = '2025-04-30' AND status = 'canceled') apc ON ac.account_id = apc.account_id

./query "SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN was_paying_prior_month_end AND NOT is_paying THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN was_paying_prior_month_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS logo_churn_rate FROM main.customer_months WHERE month_end = DATE '2025-04-30'"

./query "SELECT ROUND(SUM(s.seats * s.unit_price_minor / POWER(10, s.minor_unit_exponent) * s.usd_per_unit * (1 - s.discount_pct) / CASE WHEN s.billing_interval = 'year' THEN 12 ELSE 1 END), 2) AS mrr_usd FROM marts.fct_subscription_months s JOIN marts.dim_accounts a USING (account_id) WHERE s.month_end = '2025-06-30' AND s.status IN ('active', 'past_due') AND NOT a.is_internal AND NOT a.is_deleted"

SELECT ROUND(SUM(seats * unit_price_minor * (1 - discount_pct) / pow(10, minor_unit_exponent) / CASE WHEN billing_interval = 'year' THEN 12 ELSE 1 END * usd_per_unit), 2) AS mrr FROM marts.fct_subscription_months m JOIN marts.dim_accounts a ON a.account_id = m.account_id WHERE m.month_end = DATE '2025-06-30' AND m.status IN ('active', 'past_due') AND NOT a.is_internal AND NOT a.is_deleted

WITH deduped AS (SELECT m.* FROM marts.fct_subscription_months m JOIN (SELECT month_end, subscription_id, MAX(version_id) AS version_id FROM marts.fct_subscription_months GROUP BY month_end, subscription_id) d USING (month_end, subscription_id, version_id)), acct_status AS (SELECT m.account_id, m.month_end, CASE WHEN COUNT_IF(m.status IN ('active','past_due'))>0 THEN 'active' ELSE 'other' END AS s FROM deduped m JOIN marts.dim_accounts a USING (account_id) WHERE NOT a.is_deleted AND NOT a.is_internal GROUP BY m.account_id, m.month_end), mar AS (SELECT account_id FROM acct_status WHERE month_end='2025-03-31' AND s='active'), apr AS (SELECT account_id FROM acct_status WHERE month_end='2025-04-30' AND s='active') SELECT COUNT_IF(apr.account_id IS NULL)*1.0/COUNT(*) AS logo_churn_rate FROM mar LEFT JOIN apr USING (account_id)
